synthesis.title: Adversarial Pair Programming Graph
synthesis.summary: An adversarial pair-programming model where coding work is mapped onto a graph of scenario nodes. Each node corresponds to a distinct piece of the implementation and has a dedicated watcher unit. The watcher observes the main coding agent's actions in real time, communicates direct feedback as work progresses, and is prompted specifically to guide the agent until that node's piece is fully complete.
synthesis.limitations: Logged as an early idea only; not evaluated or expanded into an implementation plan.
